info.name: ReadEz API
info.description:
Complete API collection for ReadEz — a PDF reader web app.

Authentication is cookie-based (readez_session). Log in via Google OAuth first, then Postman will carry the session cookie automatically.

Set the `base_url` variable to your environment (default: http://localhost:8000).

request.description: Check if the API server is running.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints using Google OAuth with cookie-based sessions.

request.description: Returns a Google OAuth authorization URL. Open this in a browser to complete sign-in.
Google redirects here after user consents. Exchanges code for tokens, creates/finds user, sets session cookie. Returns HTML that posts a message to the opener window.
Get the currently authenticated user's profile. Requires session cookie.
Check whether the current session is authenticated. Does not require auth — returns a boolean.
End the current session. Deletes the session from the database and clears the cookie.

item.name: Books
item.description: CRUD operations for PDF books, thumbnails, signed URLs, and page count management.

request.description: List all books for the authenticated user, ordered by last updated.
Get a specific book by its UUID.

formdata.description: Optional title. Defaults to filename without extension.

request.description: Upload a new PDF book. Page count is automatically extracted from the PDF.
Delete a book and all associated files (PDF, thumbnail) and reading progress.
Upload or replace the thumbnail image for a book.
Get the thumbnail image for a book. No authentication required — thumbnails are public.
Generate a time-limited signed URL for accessing the book's PDF file. Valid for 1 hour.
Get the PDF file as base64-encoded JSON. Uses signed URL auth (no session cookie needed). Bypasses download interceptors like IDM.
Serve the raw PDF file using signed URL authentication.
Update the page count for a book. Used by the frontend reader as a lazy backfill — only updates if total_pages is currently null or zero.
Backfill page counts for all books belonging to the current user where total_pages is null or zero. Reads each PDF from storage and extracts the real page count.

item.name: Reading Progress
item.description: Track and restore reading position, zoom level, and scroll position per book.

request.description: List reading progress for all books, ordered by last read.
Get reading progress for a specific book.
Update reading progress for a book. Creates the progress record if it doesn't exist. All fields are optional — only send what changed.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Dodo Payments webhook endpoints. These are called by Dodo's servers, not by the client. Included here for testing with signature verification.
